newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-WEAH SAYS COSTA SHOULD WITHDRAW LAWSUIT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WEAH SAYS COSTA SHOULD WITHDRAW LAWSUIT.

text.p: AC Milan striker George Weah said on Wednesday he could not understand why Jorge Costa was pressing ahead with a claim for damages over a head-butting incident in which the Porto defender's nose was broken.
"I don't know why Costa won't withdraw the lawsuit," the Liberian player told reporters at Milan's training ground at Milanello.
"What happened happened. He was hitting me throughout the match. I apologised to him. I was suspended for six games. What more does he want?
"And now this lawsuit. I wouldn't have acted like this in his position."
Costa was out of action for six weeks after being butted by Weah in Portugal at the end of a tense European Champions' League match between Porto and Milan last November.
Weah, last year's FIFA World Player of the Year, was in Lisbon on Monday for the 1997 award to Brazilian Ronaldo and received the biggest ovation of the night.

His attendance at the ceremony, to receive a special FIFA award for fair-play, was in doubt up to the last moment because of the Costa affair. The audience burst into prolonged applause when he handed over a $6,000 donation to a children's charity.
